entities.name: Toshiaki Kosedo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Toshiaki Kosedo  is a Japanese former volleyball player who competed in the 1964 Summer Olympics. He was born in Hiroshima Prefecture. In 1964 he was part of the Japanese team which won the bronze medal in the Olympic tournament. He played three matches.
